title: Column statistics
summary: Count, sum, minimum, maximum and mean of one column's numbers.

sections.use: Summarise one column's numbers exactly: how many there are, their sum, minimum, maximum and mean.
sections.exclusions: Plain decimal numbers only: no thousands separators, currency signs, percentages or exponents; such cells count as other.
sections.limitations: Exact decimal arithmetic to 34 significant digits; rounded is true when a result was rounded. Numbers are returned as decimal strings.
sections.missing_data: With no numeric cells, sum, min, max and mean are null; the counts still add up.
sections.effects: Runs locally inside AgentWiz with no network access, files or model; it only returns a value. It has no destination, so it can run on Local only data; its output is restricted whenever an input is.
sections.failures: A refusal names a fixed code and, where it applies, a 1-based position (record, row or entry); the message never repeats your text. Check the input against the limits above and run again.

inputs.columns: The column names, as a JSON list.
inputs.rows: The rows, as a JSON list of lists of strings.
inputs.column: The name of the column to summarise.

outputs.out: The counts, sum, min, max and mean (decimal strings or null) and rounded.
